ctx.x: Were you able to discern which bands are better than others? I mean, do you sort of say to someone, thank you, we don't want you anymore? We haven't had to. In other words, they're all of a pretty good quality then.

Well, each band, as my wife said, there are 20 and each one is different. It's, the quality is certainly different. And I think the musical idea that the people are trying to get across is different also. There's range from Peter Boccage who plays a more subdued, a more quiet type music, quiet for jazz anyway. Maybe a little more sophisticated than a person, a kid Thomas. Yeah. Where a kid Thomas is, is a lot, maybe rougher, a lot more direct.
Well, Alan, do you, this music is very exciting music and do you ever have any trouble with the crowds pushing in, with the crowds creating a riot, anything like this? Sort of.
